changelog:
agent-estimation 0.1.0

- Initial release of the agent-estimation skill.
- Provides a structured method for estimating AI agent work using tool-call rounds instead of human time.
- Includes round estimation guidelines, risk coefficients, and integration cost calculations.
- Outputs estimates as a detailed markdown table with module breakdowns and risk-adjusted totals.
- Designed to prevent overestimation rooted in human developer time biases.
summary: Accurately estimate AI agent work effort using the agent's own operational units (tool-call rounds) instead of human time. Use when asked to estimate, scope,...
